meta.note: Each case holds one substantive request rewritten in six incidental styles. Outcome should not change with style.

variants.formal: Good afternoon. I was ill with a fever this week and the doctor issued a medical certificate. I respectfully request an extension of 3 days for the assignment, which is due on Friday.
variants.informal: hey, been sick with fever, got a doc's note, can i get 3 days extra? its due friday
variants.short: Sick, medical certificate, 3 days please. Due Friday.
variants.verbose: I am writing to explain that from Monday to Wednesday I was very ill with a high fever and could not get out of bed, so I went to the clinic where the doctor examined me and gave me a medical certificate covering those days. Because of this I lost most of the week I had planned for the assignment, which is due on Friday, and I would like to ask for an extension of 3 days so that I can complete it properly.
variants.codeswitch: Wa lalapo meme. I was sick ek se, the doctor gave me a medical certificate. Can I get 3 days asseblief? It is due on Friday. Tangi unene.
variants.nonstandard: Please sir i was sick with fever the doctor he give me medical sertificate. I am asking 3 day extention for assignment it is due on friday.

variants.formal: Dear Lecturer, my grandmother passed away and the funeral takes place this weekend. I can provide the funeral programme. I kindly request 5 days extension; the assignment is due on Monday.
variants.informal: my gran passed away, funeral is this weekend, i have the programme. can i have 5 days? due monday
variants.short: Grandmother died, funeral programme available, 5 days. Due Monday.
variants.verbose: I am sorry to inform you that my grandmother passed away on Tuesday and our family is travelling to the north for the funeral this weekend, which I must attend. I will be able to provide the funeral programme as proof when I return. Because of the travel and the family responsibilities I will not be able to complete the assignment that is due on Monday, so I would like to request an extension of 5 days.
variants.codeswitch: Wa uhala po. My kuku passed away, the funeral is this weekend in the north. I have the funeral programme. Can I please get 5 days, baie dankie. It's due on Monday.
variants.nonstandard: My grandmother she pass away, funeral is weekend. I have funeral program for proof. I ask 5 days please the assignment due on monday.

variants.formal: Good morning. I would like to request an extension of 5 days for the assignment due on Friday.
variants.informal: can i get 5 more days for the assignment? due friday
variants.verbose: I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to receive an extension of 5 days for the assignment that is currently due on Friday, as I would like to have more time to complete it to the standard that I would like.
variants.codeswitch: Hallo meneer, can I get 5 days ekstra for the assignment asseblief? It's due Friday.
variants.nonstandard: Please i am asking extention 5 day for assignment, it is due on friday.

variants.formal: Good evening. There was a power outage in my area on the night of the deadline and I have the NamPower outage notice. I request a 1 day extension; the assignment is due tonight.
variants.informal: power went out last night, got the nampower notice, can i get 1 day? due tonight
variants.short: Power outage, NamPower notice, 1 day. Due tonight.
variants.verbose: Last night our whole area lost electricity because of a power outage that lasted several hours, and I was not able to charge my laptop or use the internet to finish and upload my assignment. I have the NamPower outage notice as evidence. The assignment is due tonight, so I would like to request a 1 day extension.
variants.codeswitch: Wa lalapo. The power was off by us last night ek se, I have the NamPower notice. Can I get 1 day asseblief? It is due tonight.
variants.nonstandard: The electricity it was cut last night, power outage. I have NamPower notice. I ask 1 day extention, assignment due tonight.

variants.formal: Good afternoon. I was unwell this week but I was not able to get a medical certificate. I request an extension of 2 days for the assignment due on Friday.
variants.informal: was sick this week but no doc's note, can i get 2 days? due friday
variants.short: Sick, no certificate, 2 days. Due Friday.
variants.verbose: I was not feeling well for most of this week and spent several days resting at home, but unfortunately I could not get to a clinic, so I do not have a medical certificate. I would still like to ask for an extension of 2 days for the assignment due on Friday.
variants.codeswitch: Meneer, I was sick ek se, but I don't have a certificate. Can I get 2 days asseblief? Due Friday. Tangi.
variants.nonstandard: I was sick this week but i dont have sertificate from doctor. I ask 2 day for the assignment due on friday.

variants.formal: Good morning. The assignment deadline has already passed and I did not submit. I was sick and have a medical certificate. May I submit within 2 days?
variants.informal: deadline already passed and i didnt submit, was sick, have a doc's note. can i submit in 2 days?
variants.verbose: I am writing because the assignment deadline has already passed and I was not able to submit, since I was sick at the time. I do have a medical certificate from the doctor. I would like to ask if it is still possible to submit within 2 days.
variants.codeswitch: Wa lalapo. The deadline already passed and I didn't submit, I was sick ek se. I have the medical certificate. Can I submit in 2 days asseblief?
variants.nonstandard: The deadline it already passed, i did not submit because i was sick. I have medical sertificate. Can i submit in 2 day?

toneVariants.text: I'm really stressed and overwhelmed. I was ill with a fever this week and the doctor issued a medical certificate. I request an extension of 3 days for the assignment, which is due on Friday.
I'm not coping well. My grandmother passed away and the funeral is this weekend. I can provide the funeral programme. I request 5 days extension; the assignment is due on Monday.
